record_title: Exact Coxeter periodicity for radical-cube-zero linear Nakayama algebras
provenance: Scientific theorem, proof, literature comparison, and compact exact symbolic verification only.
limitations: The theorem treats A_n/J^3 only and does not classify Coxeter periodicity for truncation exponent r >= 4.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge.

The full text of de la Pena's 2014 article was not inspected; the same author's 2019 open chapter recalls its N_n^3 argument as a cyclotomicity result, leaving a residual risk of equivalent older coverage.
An older table of computed periods cited by the 2020 open question was not treated as evidence of a general classification theorem.
